correctness.rationale: The all-positive trace forces every shattered support into one radius-one ball. Its arms are coordinate lines and a triple on a single line cannot be shattered. For four supported points the three-of-four positive traces force an arm/center pattern in which a unique common ball center also contains the fourth; hence VC degree<=3. For triples, the three exhaustive types (center plus two distinct arms, three distinct arms, two same-arm plus one different) have unique common centers and explicit witnesses for all eight traces, with d=2 and q<=3 exceptional failures. Counting types gives s3=q^d[binom(d,2)(q-1)^2+binom(d,3)(q-1)^3+d(d-1)binom(q-1,2)(q-1)] for d>=3; the d=2 high-q formula and singleton/pair counts follow by direct Hamming-distance witnesses. Reconstructed endpoint d=1 and C4 H(2,2). Independent direct trace enumeration independently checked finite graph instances, but generality rests on geometric argument.
